{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Fine-gauge merino turtleneck, slim fit, hip length, deep burgundy #6B1E2E, soft wool
Straight-leg trousers, high waist, full ankle length, charcoal #3A3D42, wool-blend flannel, lined
Thermal tights under the trousers, opaque, deep black #1A1A1A, brushed microfiber
Knee-high boots, low block heel, waterproof grip sole, round toe, black #1C1B1A, treated leather with a warm lining
Long coat, single-breasted, tailored, falling just below the knee, camel #B08D63, dense wool with a cashmere blend
Wide scarf, softly draped, oatmeal #D9CBB5, thick wool
Knit beanie, close fit, charcoal #4A4D52, ribbed merino
Lined gloves, black #1C1B1A, leather with a fleece lining
Structured tote, medium size, dark chocolate #3B2A21, grain leather

This outfit suits a 20-minute walk to the office in deep frost and snow: the layers of merino, lined flannel and thermal tights hold warmth, while the dense wool coat blocks the wind. The waterproof, grip-soled boots with a low heel handle snowy pavements and road salt, and they can be wiped clean when you arrive. A turtleneck with straight trousers keeps the neat office level without extra bulk. The coat's knee-length cut keeps the line balanced on a petite frame, and the burgundy against camel and oatmeal warms up your deep-brown eyes and dark hair."}
